concept.hr: SID-ovi i grupe utvrđuju se pri prijavi; zato se nakon promjene grupe odjaviš
concept.en: SIDs and groups are fixed at logon; why you log off after a group change

summary.hr: Ana je dodana u grupu, a pristup i dalje ne radi: token i Kerberos karte nastali su pri prijavi. Odjava, nove karte, otvorena SMB sesija, replikacija.
summary.en: ana is added to a group and is still denied: her token and Kerberos tickets come from her logon. Logging off, new tickets, an open SMB session, replication.
